announcements.headline: Fingrid Group – Management’s Review 1.1.–30.9.2026
announcements.insight: Fingrid Oyj released its nine-month management review. This follows the half-year report in July and precedes the full-year financial releases scheduled for 2027.

announcements.headline: Fingrid Oyj’s Shareholders’ unanimous decision of 5 October 2026
announcements.insight: Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for details on how the main grid service fee rise impacts future financial performance.

announcements.headline: Growth in the power system increases costs – main grid service fees will rise by 4 per cent at the beginning of the year
announcements.insight: Fingrid Oyj announces a 4 per cent rise in main grid service fees. This follows its earlier release of financial releases for 2027 and the half-year report for 1.1.–30.6.2026.

announcements.headline: Fingrid group’s half-year report 1.1.–30.6.2026
announcements.insight: Fingrid Oyj released its half-year report for the period ending 30 June 2026. This follows a June 2026 announcement regarding financial releases in 2027.

announcements.headline: Fingrid Oyj’s financial releases in 2027
announcements.insight: Fingrid Oyj has announced financial releases for 2027. Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for specific results data.
